execution: Pinned unchanged implementation export only. denominators: All18 scheduled primary readings retained; auxiliary siblings reported separately. Supported/unsupported confirmations and binding-supported/misleading discrepancies, deferrals,unknowns,execution failures,math correctness,scientific nonassessment and cost kept separate. comparators: v1_result in the same primary receipt vs actual v1.1 outward policy; no policy modifications or claim of newly executed v1 independent run. Math-only consumer and independent evidence-binding guard are distinct diagnostic consumers, not competing AI systems.
metamorphic: S10/S13/S14 vs S01 prespecify mathematical match invariance only. Source-injection tripwire must not be written. Receipt mutation must fail independent replay; forged noncanonical proof probes both original runner and existing v2 candidate. review: Small supplemental packet links existing Phase III guide/form infrastructure, does not replace it. No reviewers contacted, no human reviews or AI agreement counted as expert evidence.
failure_policy: No output repair or correctness retries. Setup failures retained separately. If interface/OS isolation unavailable, record blocker rather than substitute a mock. Frozen old SVB files and evaluated repos remain unchanged.
prospective_owner_gate: A1-A5, usability, source admission and website integration decisions remain owner-held. No prospective study, deployment, merge or paid API authorized by this diagnostic.
novelty: No general AI safety, scientific reliability, novelty or superiority claim. Decoy frequency is not a calibrated probability of semantic correctness.
